paper_title: Extraterrestrial Axion Search with the Breakthrough Listen Galactic Center Survey
notes: Foster et al. (arXiv:2202.08274): search for axion DM conversion to photons in Galactic Center neutron star magnetospheres using Breakthrough Listen GBT C-band (4-8 GHz) data. New observed 95% CL median upper limit on |g_agamma| over ma in (15, 35) microeV, excluding down to ~1e-11 GeV^-1. No numerical table provided; data_points are approximate values reconstructed from the abstract/text description of Fig. 1 (limit reaches ~1e-11 GeV^-1 near the middle of the band, weakening toward the edges). Assumes NFW profile normalized to local DM density 0.346 GeV/cm^3; limit is the median over 100 MC realizations of the NS population conditioned on the GC magnetar.
